facts.fact: 叙述者总在噩梦中醒来：小丑的脸变成特朗普，父亲的脸变成 Rusty、再变成 Claude。
facts.anchor: I always wake when the Joker’s face changes to Trump’s, when Dad’s changes to Rusty’s to Claude’s.

facts.fact: 她奉政府之命伪装成黑客，潜入混沌计算机俱乐部大会做监控——代号 Winona 的她真名叫 Dell。
facts.anchor: I came on an official government dare—to become a fake hacker and run surveillance on Chaos Computer Club.

facts.fact: 男友 Rusty 假死整容，化身黑客 Claude Brisbois——「死亡是我们这行唯一的退场」。
facts.anchor: I had a little work done. New face. Tweak to the voice box. You know death is the only true exit from our job. Now you’re in, I’m out.

facts.fact: 两人现在的目标：用「眼睛眼睛眼睛」的人脸图案布料过载算法，迷惑人脸识别。
facts.anchor: The goal now is to overload the algorithm. With eyes, eyes, eyes. To divert the gaze of facial recognition software.

facts.fact: Standing Rock 抗议中 Vanessa Dundon 失明、Sophia Wilansky 手臂被震荡弹炸残——这提醒她为什么不能退出。
facts.anchor: Vanessa Dundon’s eye. Light gone forever. Sophia Wilansky’s arm mangled by a concussion grenade.

facts.fact: 童年时父亲被从家里带走，长灰发辫从他肩头回望——那双眼睛从此追踪她。
facts.anchor: No one ever told me not to look. They forgot the first time, too, when my dad was taken from our house.

facts.fact: 华盛顿大道游行中，屏幕上突然出现被折磨的 Claude——有人黑进了他们的僵尸网络。
facts.anchor: But then one of the marchers stops and screams, “What are they doing to him? Isn’t that Brisbois?”

facts.fact: 结尾：父亲的眼睛、屏幕上 Claude 的眼睛都在说「求你们了」——也许所有的眼睛最后都在说这句话。
facts.anchor: They said, Please. Or maybe all the eyes say that at the end.
